title: The Divine Comedy/Quotes
summary:
"Lok, this is the most dangerous mission I've ever planned." (Dante Vale)

"What Metz means to you, you mean to me. So if you're gonna to fight for him, I'll fight for you." (Lok Lambert)

"Dante Vale, this battle will be your last." (Rassimov) 

"Sorry, Rassimov. You're the one up for early retirement." (Dante Vale)

"Not so fast. It's time for your nap." (Zhalia Moon) 

"Filthy traitor. You'll pay for betraying the Organization!" (Alpha) 

"Probably, but not today." (Zhalia Moon before casting Darksleep)

"Impressive." (Rassimov) 

"I thank you for the compliment, but I don't care what scum like you thinks." (Dante Vale)

"It's impossible! No one could have improved so much so quickly." (Rassimov) 

"It's taken some time, but I've memorized all your moves." (Dante Vale)

"Dante! Beware the Professor, he's stronger than you think."
- Rassimov's fake last words to Dante Vale as he hands him Archwarder's amulet

"I hope that the evening finds you in good health." (The Professor) 

"Certainly in better health than you, if you don't give us what we came for." (Dante Vale)

"You know every Amulet holds a Titan. Haven't you ever wondered about this one?"
- The Professor to the Huntik team about the Amulet of Will

"I tried the honest path, but when I heard Metz was taken by the same illness, it was no longer a quest to save my own life." 
- The Professor on creating the Organiation

"Huh, let me guess. By saing him, you'll redeem yourself." (Zhalia Moon) 

"Is looking for redemption really so strange, Zhalia Moon?" (The Professor)

"Simon is still alive, buried under all these curses. If you help me, I can become him again."
- The Professor to Dante Vale

"As a Casterwill, I've got to fight evil, even if it means fighting Dante, or you!" (Sophie Casterwill) 

"Let's teach Miss Priss a lesson." (Zhalia Moon, before invoking King Basilisk)

"I can't let you hurt Dante. He means more to me than anything else in the world."
- Zhalia Moon to Sophie Casterwill

"No! I just gave it all up. It's the end."
- Dante Vale after giving the Professor his Legendary Titans
